rootCause: Global MutationObservers in exam-humanize.js and family-management.js react to broad subtree mutations. After local draft restoration adds a notice, exam-humanize repeatedly re-syncs subject mode UI; text-node rewrites can recursively retrigger the observer and saturate the main thread.
plan: Narrow exam enhancement observation to exam dialog lifecycle instead of every subtree mutation.
Emit and consume a dedicated draft-restored event so mode synchronization runs exactly when needed.
Make subject-mode synchronization idempotent so repeated calls do not rewrite unchanged DOM.
Narrow family-management observation to dashboard/settings lifecycle so exam dialog DOM changes do not trigger settings scans.
Add regression contract tests for observer scope and draft restoration behavior.
Bump package/runtime to 0.1.7, require PR CI green, expected-head merge, main CI, Cloudflare deploy and production health attestation.
resumeRule: Resume from the latest exam-freeze-v017 PR head. Do not mix invitation/recovery-account work into this hotfix. Invitation mode is deferred to v0.1.8 after production stability is restored.
